claim_boundary: This control classifies only the local evidence supplied to it. A payment acknowledgement proves receipt of the listed payment, not a granted filing date, complete application, verified claims, current pendency, patentability, freedom to operate, or absence of an outstanding notice. A filing anniversary is not, by itself, a U.S. prosecution response deadline. Foreign or PCT priority strategy can be separately time-sensitive and requires prompt review by a registered patent practitioner.
direct_answer: The local record proves a payment acknowledgement only. It does not prove a Filing Receipt, complete application, current status, verified claims, or an outstanding response deadline. The official Patent Center docket must be captured before any U.S. deadline claim. Foreign or PCT priority strategy is a separate, potentially time-sensitive counsel question.

human_action_gate.next_safe_action: After the user confirms the signed-in Patent Center application page is ready, download every missing docket category without filing, paying, or signing.

official_sources.label: USPTO incomplete or missing application information
official_sources.verified_fact: An OPAP notice identifies missing or deficient application items, the reply period, and any additional fees. The notice itself controls the response task.

official_sources.label: USPTO nonprovisional utility filing guide
official_sources.verified_fact: A nonprovisional utility application requires a specification with claims, any necessary drawings, an oath or declaration, and prescribed filing, search, and examination fees. Missing fees can produce a notice and surcharge.

official_sources.label: USPTO Patent Center
official_sources.verified_fact: Registered users can view private submissions, track application progress, inspect correspondence and fee history, and respond to USPTO correspondence.

official_sources.label: USPTO Pro Se Assistance Program
official_sources.verified_fact: The program provides procedural assistance to applicants filing without a registered patent attorney or agent, but it does not provide legal advice.

official_sources.label: USPTO Patent Pro Bono Program
official_sources.verified_fact: The program routes financially under-resourced inventors and small businesses to regional programs that may match them with volunteer practitioners.

official_sources.label: WIPO PCT restoration of priority
official_sources.verified_fact: PCT priority restoration is limited, jurisdiction-dependent, and time-sensitive. Availability must not be assumed.

required_patent_center_capture.why: Verify the official filing date, application type, entity status, continuity data, and current status.
A payment acknowledgement is not the Filing Receipt and does not establish the complete official docket posture.
Identify every OPAP notice, Office Action, abandonment notice, or other communication and its mailing date.
Verify that the official file contains the specification, claims, abstract, drawings, ADS, and oath or declaration as applicable.
Verify filing, search, examination, surcharge, excess-claim, and any other assessed or outstanding fees.
Reconcile each submission, notice, response, and status change in chronological order.
